notes.title: Golf Pool V2.0 released!
notes.content:
A Major update for Golf Pool VR has been released. a new Fine-tune system, Increase accuracy, a global Leaderboard, and an Arcade mode that includes 10 challenging levels. 
Do please replay the tutorial level to understand the new system.

Don't forget to leave your feedback on the discord channel https://discord.com/invite/ZGAHEuA

notes.title: Golf Pool VR is live now on steam!
notes.content:
Please join the discord channel https://discord.gg/ZGAHEuA to find other online players and coordinate with them to play MP match without waiting for ages. report the bugs and give your feedback in the discussion section of steam https://steamcommunity.com/app/1008700/discussions/ or on discord. your feedback is very important to shape the game during early access. 

Have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Dev Q&A
notes.content: Feel free to chat with developers and the community and share your feedback and questions about Golf Pool VR: https://discord.gg/ZGAHEuA
